rendering_device.renderer: D3D12 (NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU)

depth_precision: Metric depth is float32. D24/S8 stores 24-bit normalized depth: for optical depth z, one storage step is approximately z*z*(far-near)/(near*far*(2**24-1)) metres; projection and float32 conversion also contribute rounding.
convention: T_world_camera_cv maps camera to world; CV camera axes x-right, y-down, z-forward; integer (u,v) identifies pixel centers; RGB is top-left uint8 RGB; depth_m is optical z in metres; seg_geom_id is MjModel geom ID, -1 for non-geom/background.
